verdict.rationale: Jitsu has no built-in natural-language interface. It does run an official MCP server, documented at use.jitsu.com/mcp with OAuth 2.1 browser approval. Through it, an external AI agent can turn natural-language requests into pipeline actions: creating destinations, wiring streams, inspecting Live Events and editing Functions. So NL operation works only through a separate agent the user supplies. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface, hands-on or independent corroboration that agent-driven operation works reliably, and documentation of which operations are reachable via natural language versus only the UI, CLI or API.
